chat.title: Chat
chat.modelsSource: The deployments in Model Serving; one not ready yet is greyed out with why.
chat.sessionHint: A conversation keeps one X-Session-Id: the gateway pins the whole conversation to one inference instance, so the prefix cache stays warm.
chat.emptyTitle: Pick a model to start chatting.
chat.emptyHint: Requests go through the console to the inference gateway. The gateway key stays on the server and never reaches the browser.
chat.emptyWithModel: Type a message below to start chatting with {model}.

composer.placeholderUser: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
composer.placeholderAssistant: Write a message as the assistant: "Add" only appends it, "Send" appends it and asks the model to continue
composer.addTitle: Append to the conversation without asking the model

modelSelect.noneHint: No model is deployed yet. Deploy one under Model Serving; it shows up here once ready.
modelSelect.noneReadyHint: There are deployments, but none can chat yet:

reason.noRoute: no gateway route, cannot be called from here
reason.notPublished: route {route} is not on the gateway yet
reason.notServing: route {route} has no ready instance yet

params.systemPlaceholder: Optional. Sent as the system message in messages.
params.blankHint: Blank parameters are not sent; the engine uses its own defaults.
params.reset: Reset parameters to defaults (keeps the system prompt)

viewCode.title: View code
viewCode.description: Calls the OpenAI-compatible API with the current model, parameters and conversation. First set the environment variable {env} to an API key issued by your administrator.

errors.noBackend: This console has no llm backend configured: set the profile or configMap of playground.gateway in the chart
errors.badCredentials: The gateway rejected the credentials: check the Secret that route.auth.secretRef points to in the site profile
errors.forbidden: No permission on the llm backend: the role needs get and create on backends/llm
errors.unreachable: The gateway is unreachable or did not resolve: check the profile / ConfigMap / Service that backends.llm.gateway points to
errors.models: Could not load the model list: {error}
errors.modelsWiring: Could not load the model list: {why}
errors.modelsStatus: Could not load the model list ({status}): {message}
errors.noStream: The response has no readable stream
